newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Eurodollar easier, Euroyen flat at close.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Eurodollar easier, Euroyen flat at close.

text.p: SIMEX Eurodollars ended easier and Euroyen futures flat on Monday in moderately light trading, said dealers.
A dealer with a European bank said the Euroyen market was stuck in narrow range trading with no fresh factors to move it out of the range.
"The market already sold off on Friday in Chicago and nothing new happened in Japan today. The market should be supported at current levels in the short term," he said.
He said the risk for Euroyen is on the downside and the next big move was likely to be down.
Dealers said the market participants were mostly sidelined ahead of the Tankan corporate report due Wednesday and selling could emerge if the report was not as bad as expected.
December Euroyen settled at 99.18 against its CME close of 99.17. Volume was 4,835 contracts.
Japanese government bond futures ended softer with September contracts settling at 120.84 against their open at 120.91.
Eurodollars futures also ended weaker on follow through selling from Chicago on Friday, said dealers.
"There was just a bit of selling the morning but the market has stabilised and should stay around these levels until later in the week when we get more economic data," he said.
Among the data expected are factory orders and jobless claims for the month of July.
December Eurodollars ended at 94.12 against its IMM close of 94.15. Volume was 11,510 contracts.
